headline: US-led coalition ends mission in Iraq
description: Baghdad and Washington agreed in 2024 to wind down the coalition's mission, and its troops withdrew gradually from bases across the country. Their final withdrawal is scheduled for Wednesday, September 30. Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi declared October 1 to be celebrated as Sovereignty Day.

headline: One in Russia, the other in Ukraine: The Moreau brothers, divided by war
description: Thomas lives under Russian bombardment in Kyiv, where he represents French companies in the defense and security sectors. In Moscow, Xavier relays Vladimir Putin's propaganda.
